name: Concorde Sienna
address: Hennur–Bagalur Main Road, Kannuru, Bengaluru, Karnataka
description: Concorde Sienna is a two- and three-bedroom apartment development on Hennur Main Road, with architecture influenced by European design. Concorde describes 260 apartments across three acres, combining a high-rise residential format with a substantial open-space component. Club Evolve, landscaped recreation and privacy-focused planning form the main lifestyle proposition.

content.faqsTitle: Six things to know about Concorde Sienna

faqs.question: Where exactly is Concorde Sienna located?
faqs.answer: Hennur–Bagalur Main Road, Kannuru, Bengaluru, Karnataka, 560077. The Google Maps link uses this project and address.

faqs.question: What configurations and sizes are documented?
faqs.answer: 2 BHK, 3 BHK. Documented saleable/super built-up plan areas span 1200–1870 sq ft. The layout table identifies each area basis and applicable phase.

faqs.question: What is the published starting price?
faqs.answer: ₹1.25 Cr* Onward. The pricing record identifies the source and quoted configuration. Unpriced formats are excluded from the reference range; a current cost sheet is needed for the selected unit. Applicable charges are itemised separately by the source.

faqs.question: What is the status and possession timeline?
faqs.answer: New launch. Published timeline: July 2031 onwards, CP reference. This is a published schedule/status reference, not a fresh contractual handover confirmation.

faqs.question: What are the main amenities?
faqs.answer: Club Evolve, Swimming pool, Children’s pool, Gymnasium, Pickleball court, Multipurpose games court. Count sourced named facilities, not an invented developer total. These are published facilities; confirm which are completed and accessible to your selected phase.

faqs.question: What makes this project worth comparing?
faqs.answer: Three acres with 260 apartments G plus 28 floor arrangement 75 percent open space reported by Concorde. Aaramv can compare these features with your space needs, budget and daily routes, and help coordinate the next steps through move-in.
